sections.content: Spanish can describe eating habits by combining the present tense with frequency expressions such as normalmente, a menudo, de vez en cuando and cada día. To make the description more precise, connect habits with reasons, contrasts or time expressions rather than listing isolated actions.

items.spanish: Normalmente desayuno temprano, aunque los fines de semana como más tarde.
items.english: I normally have breakfast early, although at weekends I eat later.

items.spanish: A menudo preparo comida casera porque quiero saber qué ingredientes contiene.
items.english: I often prepare homemade food because I want to know what ingredients it contains.

items.spanish: De vez en cuando salgo a cenar, sobre todo cuando tengo poco tiempo.
items.english: From time to time I go out for dinner, especially when I have little time.

items.spanish: Después de comer, solemos quedarnos de sobremesa mientras hablamos de nuestro día.
items.english: After eating, we usually stay talking after the meal while we discuss our day.

sections.content: Use frequency expressions to show how regular a habit is, and add a connector when you explain when or why it happens.
